stories.extract:

stories.extract:
US immigration authorities could increasingly use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to identify inconsistencies across immigration filings, putting the spotlight on the accuracy of records maintained by H-1B visa holders and their employers.
A release issued by Womble Bond Dickinson, a law firm, warns that AI-assisted checks could help identify discrepancies between an employee’s reported residential address and the worksite information submitted by an employer in an H-1B petition.

stories.title: European football: Lazio beat Parma to top Serie A; Dortmund lead Bundesliga
stories.extract:
Lazio climbed to the top of Serie A with a 2-1 home win over Parma as Roma twice came from behind to secure a 3-3 draw with Napoli in a pulsating clash in Naples.
Lazio have 22 points from their eight matches this season and are three points clear of champions Inter Milan, who have played a game fewer and host Fiorentina on Sunday.
